project.name: host/host-runtime
project.description: Host-flat runtime facts and the ambient-source realisations that project them — shared by every exe that boots the framework (seed-outcluster's grow, the manifests CLI). Holds ExecutionEnclosure (the container FACT: OPERATOR vs IN_CLUSTER, a sibling of RunMode but orthogonal to it), and the host realisations of the seed-broker SecretsGateway seam (DotSecretsGateway over .secrets, TailscaleOauthClientGateway over ndh's provisioned OAuth client) composed behind ChainedSecretsGateway. HostSecretsGateways is the ONE place that maps an enclosure to its secrets chain, so the container-to-source decision lives once, not per exe. Pulumi-free (unlike its sibling pulumi-edge) so the Pulumi-free manifests CLI can depend on it.
